confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Brno prices. The RBA rate is the 4.00 pm reading on 18 November 2026. Food, coffee and beer figures come from crowdsourced cost-of-living sites, which disagree with each other and may be dated (one was last updated in July 2023). I found no cocktail price and no restaurant wine-glass price. Cocktail is set at about 3x the local beer price, and wine glass at about 1.6x. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. They are the least certain anchors, and prices in July 2026 may differ.
comparable_city_reasoning: Brno is a mid-sized Czech city with lower prices than Prague. The anchors sit slightly below Prague-level tourist pricing, with accommodation set at typical Central European second-city levels.
